title: Jim Ryder's talk "The Garment of God"
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jim Ryder's talk "The Garment of God", about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: urge everyone to listen to this talk Jim Ryder gave called the Garment of God
He was speaking at this event for Lucus Trust
tellings.difference: Places the talk at a Lucis Trust event and calls Ryder a Lockheed VP, but does not give the talk's title.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about a talk by Lockheed's Jim Ryder that Jesse Michels points listeners to; the Garment of God talk is plausibly the one given at the Lucis Trust event.
